constraints.ocl:
context Customer
inv: (self.cart <> null) and (self.customerId <> null)

context Cart
inv: (self.items->any(x | x.quantity < 10) <> null) and (self.customer <> null)

context Category
inv: self.products->any(x | x.basePrice <= 100) <> null

context OrderItem
inv: self.unitPrice >= 72 and self.unitPrice <= 93
